findings.note: In the Nov 18 loss to Atlanta he had 13 pts, 6 reb and 6 ast (25 PRA, just under 25.5) in about 34 minutes; CBS notes his scoring has dipped but says OKC's backcourt injuries should keep giving him opportunities.

Profile shows 2026 averages of 18.5 pts, 3.6 reb and 3.3 ast (about 25.4 PRA, right at the line); Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace are expected to miss extended time, and he recently sat with a left ankle sprain before returning.
Before the ankle sprain he scored a season-high 35 vs Memphis and was averaging 19.7 pts, 3.7 reb and 3.7 ast (about 27 PRA) in 27.9 minutes, which points to a ceiling well above 25.5.
